profile.headline: Software Engineer | ex-LinkedIn
profile.summary:
Staff Software Engineer at LinkedIn | Graduate Student | San Jose State University 

Staff Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience (6+ at LinkedIn) designing and scaling low-latency, high-
throughput systems for job search and ads relevance. Skilled at translating complex business goals into resilient
architectures that drive engagement, revenue growth, operational efficiency. Recognized for technical leadership,
cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring team to deliver high-impact solutions. Passionate about achieving
measurable outcomes through thoughtful architecture and data-driven experimentation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and optimized LinkedIn Ads Real Time Bidding systems, enhancing ads serving and response prediction.  
• Led a multi-quarter migration of production ML training platforms, resulting in significant improvements in clicks and impressions.  
• Automated weekly training of Ads relevance models, adapting to market changes and reducing media costs.

positions.title: Software Development iXp Intern
positions.description:
• Developing a product named Guided Buying which is e-commerce website for enterprises which also
connects buyers and suppliers. 
• Contributing reusable and generic components using Angular 6 to enhance the performance and readability of the code.
• Working on automatic form creation for purchasing non-catalog items using machine learning and natural language processing on existing data for previously created orders for similar non-catalog items.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a Mobile Application for a food and agricultural industry to handle their client accounts, activities with the clients, manage
opportunities and finding client potential that can tell the share of the industry in client business.
• Contributed to CG- Portal App which is Google play store like application using Xamarin iOS.
• Developed a Mobile App with key functionalities of Managing and maintaining a database with 4 million records of cylinders, report
generation and printing using portable Bluetooth Printer and Device location logging.
• Technologies: Xamarin iOS and Xamarin Android, C#, XCode, Azure Webservices, MySql

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed various software control system for NBI power supply system.
• Designed Operating sequence of power supply system.
• Processing and management of acquired data for Neutral Beam Injection.
• The solution relied on the base of PXI bus and Windows operating system and LabView as the programming language

positions.title: Trainee
positions.description: EETP - Silver, Gold and Platinum Certified

courses.name: Data Structures and Algorithms in C++

honors.title: SAP iXP Hackathon
honors.description: Won an iXP Hackathon(Building bridges between data sources) where we developed a chatbot integrated with slack to respond to the questions of new hire regarding payroll, benefits or infrastructure

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteered for Sharks Foundation and SAP Bike Build's "Turning Wheels for Kids" where 350 bikes were built in just four hours and all the bikes were claimed by local nonprofits and given in the hands of underserved youth.

projects.title: Chat Me SJSU
projects.description:
Technologies Used: Slack API, IBM Watson, IBM Conversation, IBM weather, NodeJS
Developed a chat bot integrated with messenger like Slack through which simple questions or problems a student has in SJSU could be
answered.
• Using IBM Watson Conversation the data is modeled and bot keep communicating with IBM Watson to get the required information.

projects.title: Kayak.com Simulation
projects.description:
Technologies Used: NodeJS, ReactJS, MongoDB, MySQL, Kafka, REST, Redis, React-chartJS)
• Implemented a 3-tier application with functions of Kayak for different travel services with objects like Users, Listings, Billing and
Administrator.
• Kafka as middleware, connection pooling, graphs, MongoDB sharding, Redis for caching
• Logs to keep track of user activities. Analytics by generating revenue and location based graphs and user activity trace.
• Performance improvement testing for 10,000 users using JMeter and Mocha.
